description: This file defines the 'Country' entity class for the Human Resource Management system. It maps to the 'hs_hr_country' database table and includes properties for country code, name, country name, ISO3 code, and numerical code, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class representing a country with properties mapping to database columns such as country code, name, ISO3 code, and numerical code.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country.

methods.name: getIso3
methods.description: Returns the ISO3 code if set.

methods.name: getNumCode
methods.description: Returns the numerical code if set.
